en-US.promotionalText: Artemis II is home. Artemis III is next. Follow every mission to the Moon with live countdowns, crew updates and the weekly Artemis Briefing.
en-US.description:
ARTEMIS TRACKER — THE ARTEMIS PROGRAM AND NASA'S MOON BASE, ALL IN ONE APP

Follow humanity's return to the Moon — and the next step: NASA's Moon Base program. Artemis Tracker covers all five Artemis missions, from the historic first flight of the Space Launch System to the buildup toward a permanent lunar presence.

WHAT YOU GET
• Live countdown to every Artemis II milestone from launch through splashdown.
• Full crew profiles for Artemis II (Wiseman, Glover, Koch, Hansen) and the announced Artemis III crew (Bresnik, Parmitano, Rubio, Douglas).
• Mission overview with SLS, Orion, Starship HLS and lunar Gateway context.
• Remote banners that surface NASA announcements, schedule shifts and live events the moment they break.
• Curated launch history and key mission documents.

ARTEMIS+ (PREMIUM)
Go premium to unlock the Artemis Briefing — Wednesday deep-dives and a short Sunday Week Ahead, plus member-only mission notes inside the app. Sober editorial coverage, no clickbait. Monthly ($3.99 with 7-day free trial) or Yearly ($19.99). Cancel anytime.

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
• Artemis+ Monthly: $3.99 per month, includes a 7-day free trial
• Artemis+ Yearly: $19.99 per year
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew in your Apple Account settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://artemistracker.app/terms-of-use.html
Privacy Policy: https://artemistracker.app/privacy-policy.html

BUILT BY SPACE NERDS
Made in Norway by Orbital Momentum AS, an independent developer who watches every launch. No ads, no gimmicks, just a clean tool for following the Moon program.
